create_roi_data_loader: create a RoIDataLoader instance with a roidb and configure loader threads and GPU enqueue threads
start_loader_with_prefill: start the RoIDataLoader worker and enqueuer threads with optional minibatch queue prefilling
shutdown_loader: shutdown the RoIDataLoader by stopping all loader and enqueuer threads and closing blob queues
enqueue_blobs_to_gpu: enqueue minibatch blobs onto a GPU BlobsQueue using FeedBlob and SafeEnqueueBlobs operator
shuffle_roidb_with_aspect_grouping: shuffle the roidb indices with optional aspect ratio grouping for balanced minibatches
